name: Dreaming Faun
text: You're most at home in wistful environs and dreamy landscapes, where sleeping through the afternoon is a regular routine. If possible, you convince others to share that dream with you. When you rest for 8 or more hours, you recover additional Hit Points equal to your level. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against sleep and effects that cause dreams or nightmares (such as the Nightmare spell).
